ns2:section.sectionText: Due to a scheduling issue, STAT 448 was temporarily closed for registration. The issue has been resolved. Priority registration for this course has been extended, and is restricted to students majoring in Statistics or Statistics & Computer Science, and Statistics Graduate Students. This restriction is expected to be removed sometime during the business day May 15, 2015. Some (but not all) seats are reserved for incoming Statistics graduate students. If you receive a Reserve-Closed error, that means the course is full except for the reserved seats.
